source_description: User-authorized updated high-leverage invention account and relevant supporting outputs; selected from a frozen local byte snapshot. The original workspace and open editor were untouched.
disclosure: User explicitly requested adding these relevant research outputs to the public repository. No private work/checkouts, experimental datasets or unprovided invention disclosures imported.

selection.scope: All scientific/source outputs, histories, code, producer calculations and failure records are recoverable by exact copy/alias. Only two path-bearing local typesetting receipts are excluded.
